_readme: Powers both the hamburger's quick model-switch buttons and the /config settings page. Each entry sends its 'command' as literal text into a terminal (same as typing it and hitting Enter) - so any slash command works. Edit this file and refresh the Spark page (no restart needed) to see changes. Confirmed live 2026-09-29: /model <id>, /effort low|medium|high, and /fast are all real. Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 exist but are version-gated (Fable 5.1 needs CLI 2.1.255+, Opus 5.5 needs 2.1.280+) - check '/model' with no args in a terminal to see what's actually unlocked before adding their ids here.
